1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 1000 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __comprises__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to __1000 nm__ in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a __different__ multivalent cation.

14) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of __greater than 1000 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of __greater than 1000 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with __the polyelectrolyte complex__; and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __N,N-dimethylacrylamide__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __the fluid is selected from the group consisting of brine or seawater__ or __a detergent-in-water solution__.
